events.title: Highland Haven is in Steam Next Fest - Come Try the Demo!
events.summary: I am very excited that Highland Haven is going to be in the Steam Next Fest event going on between October 19th - 26th! Come play the demo where you can adopt Highland cows, care for your herd, restore a ruined cottage, and craft items to sell! If you give it try, please let us know what you think of the game so far! events.title: Highland Haven is part of Companion Falls for You!
events.summary: We're excited to share that Highland Haven is taking part in Companion Falls for You, a Steam festival celebrating desktop companion games!Highland Haven is a cozy idle game that lives along the bottom of your desktop, where you can care for Highland cows, restore a ruined cottage, craft goods, hire helpers, and watch the Highlands change with the seasons.Check out Companion Falls for You to discover Highland Haven alongside a whole collection of games designed to keep you company on your deskto
